issues.evidence: TE2 supplies the pre-registered endpoint this axis has demanded since round 9 and the manuscript does not report it. Step 3 froze the target artifact, priority rule, ladder, endpoint and decision rule before any run and then measured the oracle ceiling at +0.000228 (+0.0225 %) against the 2 % bar 0.020288; the alternate step 4 measured the ceiling as a function of concentration with the exact single-region target (top-1 1.0000), giving +0.000013 (+0.0013 %, not separated), +0.000228 (+0.0225 %), +0.000462 (+0.0454 %) and +0.000994 (+0.0970 %, CI [+0.00068, +0.00134]). The gap is monotone and separated at kappa >= 5, so the measurement could have refuted the paper's central negative and instead bounds it: the weight class cannot buy even 0.1 % of the deployment-weighted error at the most extreme concentration that exists. Because it is not in the manuscript, the axis stays at 3. Reporting it would raise the axis to 4.
issues.note: The axis is limited by an authorial scope decision, not by the science. This is the single largest available readiness gain in the review.
